headline: EU Proposes New Tariffs on 14 Trading Partners Over Excess Capacity; Mexico and Norway Spared
summary: The US government proposed new tariffs on 14 of its major trading partners to address what it calls structural industrial overcapacity. Mexico and Norway are reportedly exempted.
why: Tariff proposals on major partners can reshape trade flows, supply chains and costs for exporters and importers, affecting companies and currencies across the affected economies.
why_moved: The proposal of tariffs on 14 major trading partners raises trade-policy uncertainty, which can weigh on global risk assets.
original_headline: EU propone nuevos aranceles a 14 socios comerciales por exceso de capacidad; México y Noruega se salvan
